newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Highlands says has underwriting offer.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Highlands says has underwriting offer.

text.p: Takeover target Highlands Gold Ltd said on Friday that it had an offer from Papua New Guinea institutions to invest and underwrite for a share issue to raise A$110 million which would allow a restructuring of the company.

Highlands said the offer envisaged Placer Dome Inc, which is bidding 75 cents a share for Highlands, buying Highland's 25 percent interest in the Porgera gold mine in PNG and Highlands shareholders other than Placer receiving 65 cents plus one share in a new company holding Highland's other assets.
The new company would be called Highlands Pacific Ltd.

"Discussions with underwriters are continuing with a view to signing a formal underwriting agreement to raise A$160 million as soon as possible," Highlands managing director Ian Goddard said in a statement.
The investment and underwriting offer made by the PNG institutions has been endorsed by the PNG deputy prime minister and the minister for finance, Highlands said.
Highlands said it considered that the restructuring proposal provided shareholders with a superior alternative to Placer's A$0.75 a share takeover offer, which expires on January 18.
It said its board continued to unanimously advise that shareholders reject the offer.
Placer Dome said on Thursday that it held more than 50 percent of Highlands shares.
